record.relationship: Distinct from West Bengal election restriction R3-SC-001. Longer freight holiday contains routine closure days and is not assigned same duration.

record.uncertainty: A February 14 local report documents February 13 passenger resumption, but contains a conflicting weekday label and inconsistent passenger subtotals; exact time/counts are not adopted. followup_reviews.Research finding: Narrow ordinary non-emergency passenger onset to 12 February 2026 and retain the scoped 13 February observed resumption. The stopped bus's passengers crossed on foot the prior night, so that account does not support an 11 February passenger onset. The result is one calendar-day difference, without established elapsed hours. The root fresh retrieval reproduces the contradictory weekday and arithmetic, whereas the challenger’s body showed only the arithmetic issue; the explicit 13 February date is retained with the discrepancy documented.

followup_reviews.Root decision: Accept ten targeted findings with the Albanian legal-clock qualification, police-attributed Morine endpoint and unresolved sequence, and the Benapole ordinary-passenger onset correction. Retain the explicit 13 February resumption date at calendar-day precision despite the documented inconsistent weekday; do not claim 24 elapsed hours, reliable passenger counts or stable emergency access. Formula-target suggestions become recalculation expectations. This is not a full-record audit of these ten parents.
